verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no interactive API reference or runnable-example playground for Mastra Knowledge, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path. The Studio Knowledge page is a browser for scopes and pages, and llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation. Neither is an interactive API reference with runnable examples, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
